I'll have everything ready to go down to the lake—truck packed, bait sorted—and suddenly my good line is tangled to hell, or the latch on my boat trailer is mysteriously jammed with a piece of wire, or my tackle box has been dumped and reorganized all wrong. He wants to push me out of my own home, make me look like I'm losing my grip so he can just step in and take over my house and my life.
